```yaml
name: Close Old Bot Discussions and Link Sub‑Issues

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-old-bot-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: 'This issue has been stale for 30 days and will be closed.'
          stale-pr-message: ''
          close-issue-message: 'Closing stale issue.'
          close-pr-message: ''
          days-before-stale: 30
          days-before-close: 7
          stale-issue-label: 'bot-discussion'
          close-issue-label: 'bot-discussion'
          exempt-issue-labels: 'do-not-close'
          close-issue-reason: 'not_planned'

  create-issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      issue_number: ${{ steps.create.outputs.issue_number }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Create parent issue
        id: create
        uses: ./.github/actions/create-issue
        with:
          title: 'Parent issue for sub‑issues'
          body: 'Automatically created parent issue.'

  link_sub_issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: create-issue
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Link sub‑issues
        uses: ./.github/actions/link_sub_issue
        with:
          parent_issue_number: ${{ needs.create-issue.outputs.issue_number }}
```
